units.name: Department of Business Administration
units.evidence: Official College of Business academic department table identifies Business Administration department with formal Supply Chain Management BBA concentration, substantive academic remit beyond a single core course.

decisions.reason: Current official college table maps Supply Chain Management concentration to Business Administration department. No separate SCM department invented.

sources.note: Entire current College of Business overview and academic department/degree/concentration table read. Actual Business Administration department with Supply Chain Management BBA concentration; Accounting Economics Finance and Information Systems Management separately. Graduate provision explicitly evening/accelerated/executive MBA formats, no business doctorate listed.

Entire actual Engineering and Computational Sciences PhD page read, 72 credits including 24 dissertation, proposal/dissertation defence, two concentrations Engineering Systems and Computational Sciences. Full required/elective course table read. Engineering Management and Quality Control is one common concentration core course; broad engineering design/robotics/control/manufacturing methods not automatically formal IE/OR/Ops research field.

Entire College of Engineering Degree Programs page read. Applied and Industrial Technologies BS (Mechatronics/Industrial Electronics/Aviation), Architectural/Civil/Computer/Electrical/Mechanical programmes and master concentrations. ENCS one interdisciplinary PhD repeated across departments, not separate degrees for each host. ECE description includes computer-aided manufacturing/robotics, no explicit OR/Ops research field; no IE PhD inferred.

Entire Graduate School landing read. Routes to colleges, not a full degree table. Explicit instruction to consult current catalogue; business link points MBA. No doctoral absence inferred from generic landing alone.

limitations: Current Engineering and Computational Sciences PhD is real but not counted as qualifying from generic systems/design/robotics/manufacturing methods or a single Engineering Management and Quality Control core course.
Business department current source expressly houses formal SCM degree concentration; historical advertised host equivalence is supported by current academic table, not a claimed renaming history.
Current source-bounded inventory review, not historical census.
